# ESS specification `uxsearch`

Generated from [`ess/`](https://github.com/beyond10x/uxui/tree/main/ess): `system.yaml` and one file per domain under `ess/domains/`. The engine is specified as an [Executable System Specification](https://beyond10x.github.io/ess/) (format `ess/37`, specification version `v1`) before any of it is built. Its pure functions (mutation operators, the layout model, metric computation, search strategies) are specified by their contracts only.

Search the design space of an ess-ui/1 document for the best compositions, measured by declared UX metrics over every reachable UI state, and promote one through ratchet.

| domains | entities | commands | views | events |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 8 | 29 | 56 | 42 | 51 |

The repository gate for the specification:

```console
ess specify validate --path ess
ess compile --path ess
ess ui check --path ess/ui/studio.ui.yaml --model ess
ess ui test --path ess/ui/studio.ui.yaml --model ess ess/ui/tests/studio.yaml
```

What ESS cannot express yet, and what the specification does instead, is listed in [`ess/GAPS.md`](https://github.com/beyond10x/uxui/blob/main/ess/GAPS.md). The studio, the live view of a search, is itself an `ess-ui/1` document: [`ess/ui/studio.ui.yaml`](https://github.com/beyond10x/uxui/blob/main/ess/ui/studio.ui.yaml), with the pages `targets.catalog`, `campaigns.start`, `campaigns.list`, `campaigns.climb`, `campaigns.frontier`, `variants.detail`, `variants.compare`, `promotions.list`, `promotions.detail`, `judgements.list`.

## `uxsearch.design`

The base document, the target a campaign optimises inside it, the design space declared on that target as axes of finite values, the mutation operators that realise an axis value, and the variants they produce, each identified by the digest of its canonical document.

Source: [`ess/domains/design.yaml`](https://github.com/beyond10x/uxui/blob/main/ess/domains/design.yaml).

| entity | what it is |
|---|---|
| `BaseDocument` | The ess-ui/1 document being improved, at one revision. |
| `UxDeclarations` | A uxui-declarations/1 file beside the base document, at one digest. |
| `Target` | What a campaign optimises, from one component to the whole product. |
| `DesignSpace` | The variants a target admits, declared as axes; frozen before a campaign searches it. |
| `ComponentBinding` | Whether one inner component is fixed or an axis in a wider design space. |
| `Axis` | One dimension of variation with a finite value set. |
| `AxisValue` | One value of an axis and the operator applications that realise it. |
| `MutationOperator` | A deterministic transform of an ess-ui/1 document that keeps it valid. |
| `Variant` | A base document with a choice per axis, identified by its canonical digest. |
| `AxisSwitch` | A by-hand switch of one axis value on one variant, and the variant it reached. |

Commands: `RegisterBaseDocument`, `DeclareTarget`, `DeclareDesignSpace`, `RegisterUxDeclarations`, `BindComponent`, `AddAxis`, `AddAxisValue`, `FreezeDesignSpace`, `MaterializeVariant`, `RequestAxisSwitch`, `ResolveAxisSwitch`, `FailAxisSwitch`.

Views: `BaseDocuments`, `Targets`, `TargetCatalog`, `TargetById`, `DesignSpacesOfTarget`, `DesignSpaces`, `Axes`, `AxisValues`, `Operators`, `Variants`, `VariantById`, `AxisSwitches`, `ComponentBindings`, `UxDeclarationFiles`.

## `uxsearch.journeys`

Journeys a target is evaluated on, taken from ess-ui-test/1 tests, and the state space each journey reaches on one variant within declared bounds: every UI state the engine enumerates from fixtures, scripted live events and a virtual clock.

Source: [`ess/domains/journeys.yaml`](https://github.com/beyond10x/uxui/blob/main/ess/domains/journeys.yaml).

| entity | what it is |
|---|---|
| `Journey` | A task through the UI, from one ess-ui-test/1 test, bound to one target. |
| `StateSpace` | Every UI state one journey reaches on one variant within its bounds. |
| `UiState` | One reachable configuration of a page in a state space. |

Commands: `DeclareJourney`, `RetireJourney`, `EnumerateStateSpace`, `ReuseStateSpace`, `RecordUiState`, `CompleteStateSpace`, `TruncateStateSpace`, `AbandonStateSpace`.

Views: `Journeys`, `JourneysOfTarget`, `StateSpaces`, `UiStates`.

## `uxsearch.rules`

Design rules: constraints on a variant. A hard rule prunes: a variant breaking one is never evaluated further, never enters a frontier and is never promoted. A soft rule scores. Every rule publishes its result as one metric of the catalogue; a hard rule is also one ratchet requirement, whose condition is the rule's limit.

Source: [`ess/domains/rules.yaml`](https://github.com/beyond10x/uxui/blob/main/ess/domains/rules.yaml).

| entity | what it is |
|---|---|
| `DesignRule` | A constraint on the variants of one target; hard rules prune, soft rules score. |
| `RuleVerdict` | The outcome of one rule on one variant, with its findings. |

Commands: `DeclareRule`, `RetireRule`, `RecordRuleVerdict`.

Views: `Rules`, `RuleVerdicts`, `VerdictsOfVariant`.

## `uxsearch.metrics`

The metric catalogue and the KPIs a project declares over it. A metric is a typed, pure function over evaluation data; each one becomes a ratchet measurement. A KPI is a declared objective: one metric or a declared aggregation of metrics, with a weight. The KPIs of a campaign are its objectives; the frontier is non-dominated over them.

Source: [`ess/domains/metrics.yaml`](https://github.com/beyond10x/uxui/blob/main/ess/domains/metrics.yaml).

| entity | what it is |
|---|---|
| `MetricDefinition` | One metric of the catalogue, with its unit, direction, scope and kind. |
| `Kpi` | A declared objective of a target over one or more metrics, with a weight. |

Commands: `DefineMetric`, `DeprecateMetric`, `DeclareKpi`, `ReweighKpi`, `RetireKpi`.

Views: `Metrics`, `Kpis`, `KpisOfTarget`.

## `uxsearch.evaluation`

Environments a target is evaluated in, the layout model's contract, and evaluations: every metric for one variant on one state space in one environment. An evaluation is a pure function of its input digests, so it is keyed by them and computed once.

Source: [`ess/domains/evaluation.yaml`](https://github.com/beyond10x/uxui/blob/main/ess/domains/evaluation.yaml).

| entity | what it is |
|---|---|
| `Environment` | Viewport, theme mode, input mode, text scale and motion for one target's evaluations. |
| `LayoutModel` | One version of the deterministic layout model, known by its contract. |
| `Evaluation` | Every metric for one variant on one state space in one environment, keyed by its input digests. |

Commands: `DeclareEnvironment`, `RequestEvaluation`, `ReuseEvaluation`, `RecordEvaluationResult`.

Views: `Environments`, `EnvironmentsOfTarget`, `LayoutModels`, `Evaluations`, `EvaluationsOfVariant`.

## `uxsearch.search`

Search campaigns: one target, its frozen design space, its journeys, environments and KPIs, searched by a strategy within a budget. A campaign emits progress (the climb a person watches live) and keeps a frontier: the non-dominated variants found so far.

Source: [`ess/domains/search.yaml`](https://github.com/beyond10x/uxui/blob/main/ess/domains/search.yaml).

| entity | what it is |
|---|---|
| `Campaign` | A run of the engine over one target's design space, journeys, environments and KPIs. |
| `ClimbPoint` | One step of a campaign's progress, as the studio draws it. |
| `ClimbReading` | The best value of one KPI at one step of a campaign. |
| `FrontierEntry` | A variant on a campaign's frontier, with its KPI values and the evaluations behind them. |

Commands: `StartCampaign`, `PinPolicy`, `StopCampaign`, `EndCampaign`, `RecordProgress`, `RecordClimbReading`, `AdmitToFrontier`, `MarkDominated`, `WithdrawFromFrontier`.

Views: `Campaigns`, `CampaignById`, `ClimbPoints`, `Climb`, `ClimbOfKpi`, `FrontierEntries`, `Frontier`.

## `uxsearch.promotion`

Promotion of a frontier variant: the ess-ui/1 diff it makes to the base document, gated by ratchet, accepted by a person or an authorized policy. Judgement records: a person's or a review agent's pairwise preference or finding on variants, never an input to a gate.

Source: [`ess/domains/promotion.yaml`](https://github.com/beyond10x/uxui/blob/main/ess/domains/promotion.yaml).

| entity | what it is |
|---|---|
| `Promotion` | A frontier variant proposed as the next base document, with its diff and its gate. |
| `JudgementRecord` | A pairwise preference or a finding on variants by a person or a review agent. |

Commands: `ProposePromotion`, `RecordGateDecision`, `AcceptPromotion`, `AcceptTradeOff`, `RejectPromotion`, `ApplyPromotion`, `SupersedePromotion`, `RecordJudgement`, `DispositionJudgement`.

Views: `Promotions`, `PromotionById`, `Judgements`.

## `uxsearch.ratchet`

How the engine's records map to ratchet's terms. The engine keeps no baseline of its own: metrics are ratchet measurements, hard rules and gates are ratchet requirements, the engine is an assessor that returns evidence records carrying the resolved target, ratchet decides every gate, and a promoted variant's values reach ratchet only as a proposed reference change.

Source: [`ess/domains/ratchet.yaml`](https://github.com/beyond10x/uxui/blob/main/ess/domains/ratchet.yaml).

| entity | what it is |
|---|---|
| `RequirementBinding` | Which metric of which target a ratchet requirement measures. |
| `EvidenceRecord` | One observation the engine returns to ratchet as an assessor, with its resolved target. |
| `ReferenceProposal` | The reference change an accepted promotion offers ratchet. |

Commands: `BindRequirement`, `UnbindRequirement`, `RecordMetricEvidence`, `RecordRuleEvidence`, `ProposeReference`, `RecordReferenceDecision`.

Views: `Requirements`, `Evidence`, `ReferenceProposals`.
